hero.subtitle: Industrial IoT for water and solar, drone inspection, OT security and analytics for utilities and energy producers.

context.title: The sector today
context.body: Desalination is set to supply most urban water and renewable capacity is growing fast. Utilities manage vast, remote networks where leaks, faults and security incidents are expensive and hard to see.

challenges.title: Non-revenue water
challenges.body: Water lost through leaks and inaccurate metering before it reaches customers.

challenges.title: Remote, distributed assets
challenges.body: Plants, pipelines and substations spread across large areas.

challenges.title: Operational technology security
challenges.body: Control systems that were never designed for today's threats.

useCases.title: Smart water networks
useCases.body: Live pressure, flow and leak detection across distribution zones.

useCases.title: Solar plant monitoring
useCases.body: String-level performance and inverter health with remote control.

useCases.title: Pipeline and asset inspection
useCases.body: Thermal and visual drone inspection without shutdowns.

useCases.title: OT security assessment
useCases.body: Testing and protection for SCADA and industrial control systems.

vision2030.body: Efficient water and energy systems support the National Water Strategy, the Saudi Green Initiative and renewable-energy targets.
programs: National Industrial Development and Logistics Program
